resourceLinkCandidate.title: Visualisierung: Proteinbiosynthese und Lebensbedeutung erklären
resourceLinkCandidate.description: Schematische Proteinbiosynthese im Bakterium und in einer Zelle mit Kern: nummerierte große Legende für DNA, mRNA, tRNA, Ribosom, Kernpore und Protein. Vier getrennte Motive zeigen Enzym-, Struktur-, Transport- und Abwehrfunktionen.
resourceLinkCandidate.altText: Zwei Zellen zeigen DNA→mRNA→Ribosom→Protein. Im Bakterium liegt DNA ringförmig vor; rechts liegt lineare DNA im Kern und mRNA tritt durch die Kernpore zur cytoplasmatischen Translation. Große Nummern und Legende verbinden sechs Mechanismusobjekte. Unten Enzyme, Struktur, Transport und Abwehr.

wholeCurrentGoal.title: Proteinbiosynthese und Lebensbedeutung erklären
wholeCurrentGoal.titleEn: Explain Protein Biosynthesis and Its Significance for Life
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann den Mechanismus der Proteinbiosynthese beschreiben und die Bedeutung der Proteinbildung für Lebewesen erklären.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can describe the mechanism of protein biosynthesis and explain the significance of protein formation for living organisms.

ownConcretePixelNotes.scientificMechanism: The left typical bacterium has a circular DNA double helix without a nucleus; the right eukaryotic model has a linear DNA double helix wholly inside the nucleus. Both DNA→mRNA→ribosome paths are spatially consistent. The right red mRNA crosses the marked nuclear pore before reaching the cytoplasmic ribosome. Green charged tRNA carries an orange amino-acid symbol into the ribosome; the emerging multicoloured chain represents protein. DNA stays nuclear. The bacterium/eukaryote distinction is a bounded typical model, not a universal chromosome-shape claim.
ownConcretePixelNotes.scientificFormAndGeometry: Numbers1/2/3/4/5/6 point consistently to DNA/mRNA/tRNA/ribosome/nuclear pore/protein; the row legend resolves them. The transport-function icon has a vertical arrow through the membrane channel, and structural fibres/antibody symbols are recognizable. The enzyme icon is an abstract substrate/product symbol, not an atom-balanced molecular equation or demonstrated real reaction; the schematic must keep that limit.
ownConcretePixelNotes.phoneReadability: At actual360×203 all two headings, six legend labels DNA/mRNA/tRNA/Ribosom/Kernpore/Protein and four function labels Enzyme/Struktur/Transport/Abwehr are directly readable. Main structure numbers and arrows retain adequate separation; this replaces the predecessor tiny stage/function labels with large legends.
ownConcretePixelNotes.desktopAndOriginalReadability: At actual680×383 and1672×941 the structures, legend and function headings are clear, no clipping or overlap.
ownConcretePixelNotes.actorAndOutsideViewerPerspective: No learner/instructor characters or action-selection perspective in these diagrams; outside viewer sees consistent labelled schematic compartments and directional arrows. No technical tools/editor inside product scene.
ownConcretePixelNotes.comicFormatAgeAndGoalFit: PNG landscape approx16:9, friendly clear comic schematic with rounded panels, strong contrast and simple colours; appropriate for upper-school mechanism overview. No gratuitous distress, diagnosis, stereotype or unsupported patient claim.
nonblockingLimits: This overview is not a complete molecular sequence, codon/anticodon alignment, processing assay or real protein-function measurement. Function icons are symbolic. No new P/source/native claim.

targetedFirstFindingsResolved.evidence: Large six-item two-row legend plus enlarged four function labels really visible at360; nucleus and mRNA export geometry independently rechecked.

ownMetadataReason: Spacing/punctuation corrections preserve the exact two-cell protein-synthesis overview, numbered six-object legend and four protein-function motifs. The current actual-view reconstruction remains literally unchanged. No new mechanism/structure/real-experiment claim is added.

resourceLinkCandidate.title: Visualisierung: Virale Vermehrung und Wirts-Proteinbiosynthese erklären
resourceLinkCandidate.description: Schematischer HIV-Zyklus mit RNA→DNA, Integration, neuer RNA, Proteinproduktion, Genom-RNA-Verpackung, Knospung und Reifung. Reife Partikel tragen charakteristisch konische Kapside; unreife Partikel eine runde innere Proteinschicht. Reifung kann die Knospung begleiten oder ihr folgen.
resourceLinkCandidate.altText: Sechs nummerierte Felder zeigen HIV-RNA zu DNA, Integration in die Wirts-DNA, Transkription mit einer Route für genomische RNA und einer Route zur Translation, virale Proteine, Aufbau und Knospung sowie den Übergang vom unreifen zum reifen Partikel. Nur reife HIV-Kapside sind konisch; die dargestellten Partikel enthalten jeweils zwei RNA-Stränge.

wholeCurrentGoal.title: Virale Vermehrung und Wirts-Proteinbiosynthese erklären
wholeCurrentGoal.titleEn: Explain Viral Replication and Host Protein Biosynthesis
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann den Eingriff von Viren in die Proteinbiosynthese ihres Wirts und den Vermehrungszyklus von Viren beschreiben, um Auswirkungen auf den Wirt und mögliche Therapieansätze zu erläutern.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can describe how viruses interfere with host protein biosynthesis and viral replication cycles to explain effects on the host and possible therapeutic approaches.

ownConcretePixelNotes.scientificMechanism: HIV model follows1 RNA→DNA in cytoplasm,2 DNA integration in host nuclear DNA,3 transcription to new red RNA,4 host ribosome translation to protein,5 RNA plus protein assembly and budding,6 protease-like scissors cleavage/reorganization from immature spherical lattice to mature conical core. The new RNA panel sends separate red arrows toward translation and RNA packaging; the blue protein branch joins assembly. This explicitly avoids interpreting proteins alone as new genomic RNA. Nuclear proviral DNA stays integrated; viral RNA goes to the cytoplasm.
ownConcretePixelNotes.scientificFormAndGeometry: The entering mature HIV and the right Reif particle have recognizably tapered cone/truncated-cone cores, whereas the immature particles have a spherical peripheral bead lattice. This is the relevant mature-vs-immature structural distinction documented by the previously independently read Zhao2013 primary HIV-capsid research. Budding membrane geometry and arrow flow1→2→3 branching4/5→6 are coherent. Scissors denote maturation cleavage; they are not a claim of clinical drug efficacy.
ownConcretePixelNotes.phoneReadability: At actual360×203 HIV, RNA→DNA, Integration, Neue RNA, Proteine, Aufbau+Knospung, Reifung, Unreif/Reif and Ribosom are directly readable. Six large numbered panels and the red branch/blue synthesis arrows remain distinguishable; the previous microscopic integration/RNA/protein keys are gone.
ownConcretePixelNotes.desktopAndOriginalReadability: At680×383 and1672×941 all stage headings, particle core shapes, RNA branch and ribosome are clear. No mislabeled direction, missing core transition or visual clipping seen.
ownConcretePixelNotes.actorAndOutsideViewerPerspective: No learner/instructor characters or action-selection perspective in these diagrams; outside viewer sees consistent labelled schematic compartments and directional arrows. No technical tools/editor inside product scene.
ownConcretePixelNotes.comicFormatAgeAndGoalFit: PNG landscape approx16:9, friendly clear comic schematic with rounded panels, strong contrast and simple colours; appropriate for upper-school mechanism overview. No gratuitous distress, diagnosis, stereotype or unsupported patient claim.
nonblockingLimits: Bounded HIV cycle example, not all virus families; condensed release/uncoating/transport, transcriptional isoforms and enzyme choreography; scissor symbol provides a mechanism for a possible protease target but no measured treatment outcome or resistance claim. The new large-heading model has six illustrated stages rather than implying one mandatory seven-step taxonomy.

targetedFirstFindingsResolved.evidence: Actual mature entering and Reif particle cores are visibly tapered rather than predecessor faceted polygon shells; immature sphere explicitly distinct.
Six enlarged panel labels and Ribosom/Unreif/Reif remain readable at360.

ownMetadataReason: The revised prose clearly separates genome-RNA packaging and translation routes and correctly states that the depicted particles each contain two RNA strands. Mature conical versus immature round inner-shell morphology and flexible budding/maturation timing are retained. The current actual-view reconstruction remains literally unchanged. No generalisation to all viruses or clinical efficacy claim is added.
